title: Law to require a benefits toolkit for older New Yorkers
summary: This bill would require the Department for the Aging, working with the Cabinet for Older New Yorkers, to create an informational toolkit on programs, benefits and services for New Yorkers aged 60 and older, including rent freeze and meal delivery programs and agency contacts. DFTA would have to distribute printed copies annually at older adult centers and to homebound seniors, post a digital version online and update the toolkit regularly. Materials must be available in English and other citywide languages and include accessibility features like large print and braille.
